info.title: My Activity Stats API
info.description: Canonical cross-backend HTTP contract. Existing URLs are preserved. GET endpoints also support HEAD (same status and headers, no body). Unsupported methods return 405 with Allow; unknown API URLs return 404 JSON. Every API response includes X-Request-Id. Object schemas with additionalProperties remain intentionally partial until domain DTO coverage is extended.

parameters.name: week
parameters.description: Local date YYYY-MM-DD. Normalized to Monday; ISO weeks may cross calendar years. Independent of year filter.

get.summary: Weekly training load with activity evidence and four preceding weeks

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Echoed when it matches the pattern; otherwise a new ID is generated.

NotFound.description: Resource or API endpoint not found

code.description: Legacy application code: 1 for API errors, 403 for an origin rejection. Use the HTTP status for error classification.

bestPowerFor20Minutes.description: Compatibility alias of bestPowerFor20minutes; retained in both backends. Unit: W.

bestPowerFor60Minutes.description: Compatibility alias of bestPowerFor60minutes; retained in both backends. Unit: W.

ActivitySummary.description: Activity list representation. Legacy numeric summary fields use zero for unavailable metrics; inspect detailed streams before calculating load.

AthletePerformanceSettings.description: Manual FTP history ordered by effectiveFrom; the last valid entry on or before the activity date applies. weightKg is the current manual body mass, not historical body mass. Missing/null weight is unavailable.

deviceWatts.description: True for power-meter measurements, false for estimated or unavailable power. Check stream.watts separately.

activityComparison.description: Optional metadata. Omitted and null both mean unavailable.

source.description: Optional metadata. Omitted and null both mean unavailable.

DetailedActivity.description: Activity details in SI units unless explicitly stated. stream=null means no recorded series. Legacy numeric summary fields can be zero when unavailable; zero alone is not evidence of a measurement. deviceWatts identifies measured versus estimated power when power data exists.

StravaSegmentEffort.description: Shared segment effort fields; achievements, activity and athlete are optional provider metadata currently emitted by Kotlin.

distance.description: Per-sample values in m; indexed against time.

time.description: Per-sample values in s; indexed against time.

latlng.description: Per-sample values in degrees; indexed against time.

heartrate.description: Per-sample values in bpm; indexed against time.

cadence.description: Per-sample values in rpm; indexed against time.

altitude.description: Per-sample values in m; indexed against time.

watts.description: Power in W. Nullable samples are accepted by the contract; Kotlin can emit null entries. Legacy Go storage currently decodes null samples as zero (tracked separately); this endpoint does not establish measurement coverage.

velocitySmooth.description: Per-sample values in m/s; indexed against time.

ActivityStream.description: Time-indexed sensor arrays. time contains elapsed seconds from the activity start, not sample indexes. Sampling intervals may be irregular. An absent, null or empty sensor array contains no usable samples. Zero is an actual reading in a populated array; do not infer coverage from summary fields. Arrays may have different lengths; consumers must check coverage.

value.description: Formatted display string, which may include a unit or unavailable marker. Not a machine-readable numeric metric; do not parse it for training-load calculations.

FtpEstimate.description: Power-derived estimate with its evidence and time window. When available=false, numeric zeros are sentinels and must not be treated as a measured FTP.

load.description: Observed seconds / 3600 × (normalized power / dated FTP)^2 × 100. Null means unavailable, zero is measured zero.

ftpEffectiveFrom.description: Most recent valid manual FTP entry on or before activity local date. No current-profile fallback.

measuredLoad.description: Sum of available scores from measured power only; null if none. Inspect scoredCount/activityCount for missing load.

estimatedLoad.description: Separate sum from estimated power; never silently combined with measured load.

RequestId.description: Request correlation identifier, also included in JSON errors.
